questions.prompt: You move a prompt from one image model to another. What is true about negative prompts?

options.text: Every vendor wants a list of "no" words at the end of the prompt.
options.explanation: Gemini's guide asks you to describe the scene in positive words instead of saying "no cars".

options.text: Every vendor wants a separate negative field with plain words in it.
options.explanation: That is the rule in Google's older Imagen guide. Gemini and OpenAI put the wish in the prompt itself.

options.text: Each vendor handles them its own way, so read the guide for your model.
options.explanation: Right. The Gemini API docs describe the scene positively, the OpenAI docs state exclusions plainly, and the older Imagen guide uses a separate negative prompt.

questions.prompt: What does OpenAI's GPT Image prompting guide say about prompt format?

options.text: Only JSON works. Other formats are ignored by the image model.
options.explanation: The guide lists JSON-like structures as one option among several.

options.text: Many formats can work; pick the one easiest to read and update.
options.explanation: Right. Short prompts, paragraphs, JSON-like structures, instructions and tags can all work.

options.text: Only one long paragraph works. Lists and labels confuse the model.
options.explanation: The guide suggests labeled sections for complex requests.

questions.prompt: With OpenAI's image generation tool in the Responses API, what is revised_prompt?

options.text: The version of your prompt that the mainline model rewrote, which you can read.
options.explanation: Right. OpenAI's docs say the mainline model revises your prompt automatically, and this field shows the revision.

options.text: An error message that says your prompt was too long and must be shortened.
options.explanation: It is not an error. It is the rewritten prompt.

options.text: A field where you must type a second, improved prompt before the image is made.
options.explanation: You don't write it. The mainline model writes it, and you read it.
